documented_probe: C-07c78691 (evaluate a trained policy deterministically under a fixed-seed environment) is the entire task: the agent must consume a persisted trained policy (policy.npz MLP), replicate a documented fixed-seed environment recipe (reward table then start states drawn from one numpy Generator in a fixed order), run a multi-episode reward-collection loop with action-dependent transitions, and emit a stable mean reward. The verifier executes the deliverable twice per case (exact determinism) and against its own independent rollout on the visible plus three hidden fixtures (different seeds, state/action sizes, horizons, episode counts, tie-breaking cases), and enforces the min_mean_reward release floor so a mis-loaded policy that scores poorly fails.
notes: Single-stage but precision-critical: exact replication of a seeded environment (rng consumption order, argmax tie-breaking to the lowest action, float64 forward pass, clamped-free modular transition), a hard determinism check (two runs must agree exactly), an exact-match check against an independent reference rollout, and a release-floor threshold. rubric: reasoning_depth 2 (seeded recipe + policy forward semantics), quantitative_correctness 2 (float rewards, per-episode list, mean over E*T), hidden_case_generalization 2 (3 hidden fixtures with varied shapes/seeds), adversarial_inputs 1 (tied rewards, repeated start states), tool_breadth 1 (numpy only). No resource pressure or statefulness; totals bucket to hard via the precision requirements.
